description: Play the next scenes of a session in forms the client shows to the learner (MCP elicitation), with no model turn between an answer and its verdict (a prototype). A screen to read is acknowledged; a quiz is answered with a displayed choice and an optional confidence. Each form carries the public screen only, and the verdict of an answer opens the next form. When a concept map exists, every scene form offers map:true; its map form accepts contest_concept:<concept id> with claim:known|unsure, or accepts empty to return to the scene. A contest asks its check questions in forms and then resumes the scene. It hands back to the conversation when a scene needs written words, when the learner declines or closes a form (they want to talk, or a hint), at the end of the lesson, or after max_steps. Returns {status: complete | needs_conversation | paused | limit | unsupported, reason?, steps[{scene_id, scene_type, correct?, confidence?} | {scene_id, scene_type:"map"} | {scene_id, scene_type:"contest", concept_id, claim}], presentation?, display_markdown, note, brief?}. Show display_markdown, do not replay the listed steps (the learner saw them), and call it again once the conversation step is done. Every hand-back except unsupported carries brief, the get_companion_brief object with its cursor moved: do not call get_companion_brief for these acts. Offer it once, on the learner's yes; status unsupported means this client shows no forms: relay in the conversation.

max_steps.description: forms to show at most; default 20

name: play_in_forms
